senses.gloss: शुर् vt. 4Ā (pres. शूर्यते) 1. To hurt, to injure, to kill; 2. to make firm or immovable.
शूर् vi. 10U (pres. शूरयति-ते) 1. To be powerful, to act the hero; 2. to make great exertion.
सूर् vt. 4Ā (pres. सूर्यते) 1. To hurt, to kill; 2. to make firm.
शूर (I) a. (f. रा) Brave, mighty, valiant, अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि Bg.i.4.
शूर (II) m. 1. A hero, a warrior; 2. a lion; 3. a boar; 4. the sun; 5. the sāla tree.
शूर (I) a. (f. रा) Brave, mighty, valiant, अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि Bg.i.4.
सुर m. 1. The sun; 2. a god, प्रेणिपत्य सुरास्तस्मै शमयित्रे सुरद्विषाम् R.x.15; 3. the number ‘thirty-three’; 4. a sage, a learned man.

सुरा f. 1. A spirituous liquor, wine (it is of three kinds- गौडी पैष्ठी च माध्वी च विज्ञेया त्रिविधा सुरा । यथैवैका तथा सर्वा न पातव्या द्विजोत्तमैः M.xi.94); 2. water; 3. a drinking vessel; 4. a snake.
सूर m. 1. The sun; 2. the Arka plant; 3. the Soma; 4. a wise or learned man; 5. a hero, a king.
शूर-कीट m. a contemptible warrior.
शूरंमन्य a. one who thinks himself a hero.
शूर-सेन (I) m. name of a country near Mathurā.
शूर-सेन (II) m. pl. the people of this country.
शूरण m. A kind of esculent root.
सूरण m. Name of an esculent root.
शूर्प (I) m.n. A winnowing basket.
शूर्प (II) m. A measure equal to two Droṇas.
सूर्प m.n. 1. A winnowing basket; 2. a measure of two droṇas; 3. another kind of measure.
शूर्प-कर्ण m. an elephant.
शूर्प-णखा, -णखी f. name of a sister of Rāvaṇa. (See App. II.)
सूर्प-णखा f. See शूर्पणखा.

शूर्प-वात m. wind raised by shaking a winnowing basket.
शूर्प-श्रुति m. an elephant.
शूर्पी f. 1. A small winnowing basket; 2. an epithet of Śūrpaṇakhā.
शूर्म m. 1. An iron image; 2. an anvil.
शूर्मि m.f. 1. An iron image; 2. an anvil.
शूर्मी f. 1. An iron image; 2. an anvil.
सूर्मि(र्मी) f. 1. An iron image of a woman, M.xi.103; 2. tha pillar of a house; 3. brightness, radiance, flame.

शूर्मिका f. 1. An iron image; 2. an anvil.
सुर-अंगना f. a celestial woman, an apsaras.
सुर-अधिप m. an epithet of Indra.
सुर-अरि m. 1. a demon; 2. the chirp of a cricket.
सुर-अर्ह n. 1. gold; 2. saffron.
सुर-आचार्य m. an epithet of Bṛhaspati.

सुर-आलय m. 1. the mountain Meru; 2. heaven, paradise.

सुरंग-धातु m. red chalk.
सुरंजन m. The betel-nut tree.
सुरत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Playful; 2. much enjoyed; 3. compassionate, tender.

सुरभि (I) a. 1. Sweet-smelling, fragrant, तदाननं मृत्युरभि क्षितीश्वरः R.iii.3, Megh.i.16; 2. agreeable, charming, pleasing; 3. handsome, beautiful, तां सौरभेयीं सुरभिर्यशोभिः R.ii.3; 4. beloved, friendly; 5. celebrated, famous; 6. wise, learned; 7. good, virtuous.
सुरभि (II) m. 1. Fragrance, perfume; 2. nutmeg; 3. resin; 4. the champaka tree; 5. the śamī tree; 6. the kadamba tree; 7. a kind of fragrant grass; 8. the season of spring.
सुरभि (III) n. 1. A fragrant smell, fragrance; 2. sulphur; 3. gold.

सुरभि (IV) f. 1. The gum of the olibanum tree; 2. the sacred basil; 3. jasmine; 4. a sort of perfume; 5. spirituous liquor; 6. the earth; 7. a cow; 8. name of the fabulous cow of plenty, आसीत्कल्पतरुच्छायामाश्रिता सुरभिः पथि R.i.75.
सुरभि-घृत n. fragrant butter, well-seasoned ghee.
सुरभि-मत् m. an epithet of Agni.
सुरभि-मास m. (the fragrant month) the spring.
सुरभि-मुख n. the commencement of spring.
सुरभिका f. A sort of plantain.
सुरस (I) a. (f. सा) 1. Well-flavoured, juicy, savoury; 2. elegant (as a composition).

सुरूप (II) m. An epithet of Śiva.
सुरूप (I) a. (f. पा) 1. Well-formed, handsome, e.g. सुरूपं शरीरं नवीनं कलत्रम्; 2. wise, learned.

सूरि m. 1. The sun; 2. a learned man, a paṇḍit, a sage, अथवा कृतवाग्द्वारे वंशेऽस्मिन् पूर्वसूरिभिः R.i.4; 3. a priest; 4. a worshipper; 5. a common title of Jaina teachers; 6. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
